raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions step derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), which was introduced by the 2026-01-16 DE-398 refactor. Ingest runs at 02:00 the day after the transaction, so every POSTED row (4600) is shifted by one day, matching the alert count.
